chapters.title: Return (depth, lca) pairs

frames.caption: Return (depth, lca) pairs — O(n) time, O(h) extra space. Input: lca_deepest_leaves(root=tree (3)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
if ld == rd: → true (ld = 0, rd = 0) — node moves to (6); rd = 0; ra = None
return ld + 1, node — dfs returns (1, (6)) to dfs (deepest nodes on both sides)
if ld == rd: → true (ld = 0, rd = 0) — node moves to (7); rd = 0; ra = None
return ld + 1, node — dfs returns (1, (7)) to dfs (deepest nodes on both sides)
if ld == rd: → true (ld = 0, rd = 0) — node moves to (4); rd = 0; ra = None
return ld + 1, node — dfs returns (1, (4)) to dfs (deepest nodes on both sides)
if ld == rd: → true (ld = 1, rd = 1) — node moves to (2); ld = 1; la moves to (7); rd = 1; …
return ld + 1, node — dfs returns (2, (2)) to dfs (deepest nodes on both sides)
if ld == rd: → false (ld = 1, rd = 2) — node moves to (5); la moves to (6); rd = 2; ra moves to (2)
return (ld + 1, la) if ld > rd else (rd + 1, ra) — dfs returns (3, (2)) to dfs
if ld == rd: → true (ld = 0, rd = 0) — node moves to (0); rd = 0; ra = None
return ld + 1, node — dfs returns (1, (0)) to dfs (deepest nodes on both sides)

return ld + 1, node — dfs returns (1, (8)) to dfs (deepest nodes on both sides)
if ld == rd: → true (ld = 1, rd = 1) — node moves to (1); ld = 1; la moves to (0); rd = 1; …
return ld + 1, node — dfs returns (2, (1)) to dfs (deepest nodes on both sides)
if ld == rd: → false (ld = 3, rd = 2) — node moves to (3); ld = 3; la moves to (2); rd = 2; …
return (ld + 1, la) if ld > rd else (rd + 1, ra) — dfs returns (4, (2)) to lca_deepest_leaves. Result: (2)
